instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Betty Crocker peanut butter cookie mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
FOR THE COOKIES: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Place cookie mix, oil, water, and egg in a medium bowl. Stir well until a soft cookie dough forms.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (496 g) box peanut butter cookie mix
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 egg

instructions.primary_message: Using a rounded tablespoon measure, roll dough into 15 balls. Divide dough balls between the baking sheets, spacing them 2 ½-inches apart. Using a fork, press down on each ball in a crisscross pattern, to flatten the cookies.
Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and bake until the cookies are almost done, 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Place one marshmallow on top of each cookie. Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to bake until marshmallows are puffy and begin to soften, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the cookies come out of the oven, immediately spray the back of a silicone spatula with cooking spray and gently press each marshmallow to flatten. Allow cookies to cool to room temperature.
FOR THE CHOCOLATE ICING: When the cookies are cool, using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into a medium bowl.
Place butter in a medium saucepan. Set over medium heat to melt, stirring occasionally.

Once the butter is melted, add cocoa powder, milk, and vanilla to the pan; whisk to combine. Add powdered sugar, ½-cup at a time, whisking well after each addition. Remove from heat and continue to whisk until frosting is smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cocoa powder
3 tbsp whole milk
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Using a spoon, immediately drizzle the chocolate frosting over the cooled cookies.
Allow frosting to cool and harden before serving. Enjoy!
